newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Goodman restructures NZ administration.
newsitem.headline: Goodman restructures NZ administration.

text.p: Australian food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Thursday that it had restructured its administration and management arrangements in New Zealand to improve efficiency and gain synergies among its business units.
The company said it was relocating its New Zealand corporate office to East Tamaki, Auckland, to share a site with its New Zealand Milling and Baking office.
"The changes announced today do not affect the New Zealand board of management nor the commitment of Goodman Fielder to its New Zealand operations," the company said.
